episodeTitle.en: Good Strategy, Bad Strategy | Richard Rumelt
episodeTitle.zh: 《优秀战略与糟糕战略》|理查德·鲁梅尔特

guestBioOfficial.en: Richard Rumelt is a legend in the world of strategy. He’s the author of Good Strategy/Bad Strategy and The Crux: How Leaders Become Strategists, both of which are often recommended by guests on this podcast. From his early days teaching in Iran at a Harvard-sponsored business school to teaching at Harvard Business School itself to over four decades teaching at UCLA’s Anderson School of Management, Richard’s impact resonates globally. His strategic insights are sought after by major corporations including Microsoft, Shell, Apple, AT&T, Intel, and Commonwealth Bank and by governmental organizations such as the U.S. Army Special Operations Command. In this episode, we discuss: • The essential components of a good strategy
guestBioOfficial.zh: 理查德·鲁梅尔特是战略领域的传奇人物。他著有《优秀战略/糟糕战略》和《关键所在：领导者如何成为战略家》两本著作，这两本书常被本播客的嘉宾推荐。从他早年在伊朗哈佛商学院赞助的商学院任教，到哈佛商学院任教，再到加州大学洛杉矶分校安德森管理学院任教四十余年，理查德的影响力享誉全球。他的战略见解深受微软、壳牌、苹果、AT&T、英特尔、联邦银行等大公司以及美国陆军特种作战司令部等政府机构的追捧。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• 优秀战略的核心要素

title.en: Good Strategy, Bad Strategy | Richard Rumelt
title.zh: 《优秀战略与糟糕战略》|理查德·鲁梅尔特

summary.en: Rumelt defines strategy as a coherent design for overcoming a high-stakes challenge, built from a diagnosis, a guiding policy, and focused actions. He explains why bad strategy is so common - fluffy goals without diagnosis or action - and how power (asymmetry and advantage) is the hidden engine of real strategy. The conversation is a clear, story-driven tour of what separates great strategy from noise.
summary.zh: Rumelt 将战略定义为“克服高难度挑战的一贯设计”，由诊断、指导方针与聚焦的行动三部分构成。他解释了糟糕战略为何如此普遍——只有模糊目标而缺诊断与行动——以及“权力（power）”（不对称与优势）为何是真正战略的隐藏引擎。本期以清晰、富含故事的方式，剖析了卓越战略与空洞噪声之间的区别。
